In $\triangle \mathrm{BCE}$, using sine rule, $\begin{aligned}\frac{\mathrm{a}}{\sin \left(180^{{}^{\circ}}-3 \alpha\right)}&=\frac{\mathrm{CE}}{\sin 2 \alpha}\\ \Rightarrow \quad \mathrm{CE}&=\frac{\mathrm{a} \sin 2 \alpha}{\sin 3 \alpha} \end{aligned}$ Now, in $\triangle \mathrm{DCE}$, $\begin{aligned}&\sin 3 \alpha=\frac{h}{C E}\\ &\Rightarrow \quad \sin 3 \alpha=\frac{h}{a \sin 2 \alpha / \sin 3 \alpha} \quad \text{ [from Eq.
